title: Fractional N PLL with Delta Sigma Modulator
text: Frequency synthesizer with delta sigma modulator based fractional N PLL architecture, 1 input, 1 output, {Loop filter type} sets Order of the loop filter 3rd Order; {Edit System} sets the break library block links and replace internal variables by appropriate values, {Enable increased buffer size}, {Buffer size for loop filter}, {Buffer size for PFD, charge pump, VCO, prescaler} sets the buffer size for PFD, charge pump, VCO, {Deadband compensation (s)} sets the delay added for active output near zero phase offset, {Enable impairments} adds circuit impairments to simulation, {Output step size calculation} determines how output step size is calculated, {Maximum frequency of interest (Hz)} sets the maximum frequency of interest at output, {Rise/fall time (s)} sets the 20% – 80% rise/fall time for up output port of PFD, {Propagation Delay (s)} sets the delay from input port to output port of PFD, {Output current (A)} sets the design output current 1e-3, {Input threshold (V)} sets the logic switching threshold at input ports, {Enable current impairments} adds current impairments to simulation, {Current imbalance (A)} sets the difference between full scale positive and negative current, {Leakage current (A)} sets the output current without any, {Enable timing impairments} adds timing impairments to simulation, {Propagation delay (s)} sets the total propagation delay from up input port to output port of charge pump, {Rise/fall time} sets the 20% – 80% rise/fall time for down input port, {Specify using} defines how VCO output frequency is specified Voltage, {Voltage sensitivity (Hz/V)} sets the measure of change in output frequency of VCO, {Free running frequency (Hz)} sets the vCO output frequency without control voltage, {Control voltage (V)} controls voltage values, {Output frequency (Hz)} sets the vCO output frequency values, {Output amplitude} sets the maximum amplitude of VCO output voltage, {Add phase noise}, {Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)} sets the frequency offsets of phase noise from carrier frequency, {Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)} sets the phase noise power at specified frequency offsets relative to the carrier, {Estimate phase noise parameters} sets the automatically estimate phase noise, {Period jitter (S)} sets the standard deviation of period jitter, {Flicker corner frequency (Hz)} sets the corner frequency of flicker noise, {Plot fit} plots specified and expected VCO output phase noise density, {Fractional clock divider value} sets the value by which the clock divider divides the input, {Delta Sigma Modulator order} sets the order of the Delta Sigma Modulator 3rd, {Min clock divider value} sets the minimum value by which clock divider can divide input, {Filter component values} Determines how filter components are computed, {Loop bandwidth (Hz)} sets the frequency at which magnitude of open loop transfer function becomes, {Phase margin (degrees)} sets the phase of open loop transfer function at loop bandwidth subtracted, {C1 (F)} sets the capacitance 1 3e-11, {C2 (F)} sets the capacitance 2 3.3e-10, {C3 (F)} sets the capacitance 3 2.15e-12, {C4 (F)} sets the capacitance 4 1e-12, {R2 (ohms)} sets the resistance 2 2.33e+03, {R3 (ohms)} sets the resistance 3 2.98e+04, {R4 (ohms)} sets the resistance 4 12e3, {Operating temperature (℃)} sets the temperature to determine the level of thermal, {Export Loop Filter Component Values} sets the export loop filter component, {PFD up and PFD down (pfd_up and pfd_down)} selects to probe PFD outputs, {Charge pump output (cp_out)} selects to probe charge pump output, {Loop filter output (lf_out)} selects to probe loop filter output, {Prescaler output (ps_out)} selects to probe prescaler output, {Open Loop Analysis} plots the presimulation open loop analysis, {Closed Loop Analysis} plots the presimulation closed loop, {Plot Loop Dynamics} plots loop dynamics of PLL, {Estimate phase noise}, {Reference frequency (Hz)} sets the reference frequency of input, {Resolution bandwidth (Hz)} sets the smallest positive frequency that can be resolved, {Frequency offset vector (Hz)} sets the frequency points relative to fundamental frequency where phase noise is calculated, {Target phase-noise levels (dBc/Hz)} sets the target phase noise profile for given frequency offset and {Plot estimated phase noise} plots estimated input clock phase noise. Values come from the instance.
